public.title: Memoize II
public.description: input {calls}; each call has args (integer array). A memoized function returns the sum of its arguments; cache by the entire argument tuple, preserving order and length. Return {values,executions}, where executions counts actual cache misses. This adapter tests multi-argument caching observably rather than exposing callbacks. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Serialize the full tuple into a cache key and use presence rather than result truthiness. O(total argument count) time and space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
